# Third-party model provenance

- InceptionTime: `hfawaz/InceptionTime`, commit
  `952d115e83fb3a66d75c5858c702f8dd5eeb18b7`. Only the classifier, utility
  module, upstream README, and GPL-3.0 license required by the evaluation are
  retained.
- Multi-Model LSTM: `Tuan-T/Walking-Gait-Identification`, author model class
  `LSTM_6Chan_OU`. Only the model definition and upstream README required by
  the matched reconstruction are retained.

The adapted evaluation scripts document every compatibility change. No
third-party dataset is copied into this repository.
